motivation: CF2 improves both binary criteria on query [2335,13279] at budget 5 using a one-edge exchange. The alternative has greater capped-retained-minus-deleted objective, but is rejected by the existing removed-probability non-increase condition even though necessity remains successful.
change: Binary-monotone retains strict objective increase and both binary non-regression guards but allows continuous retained/deleted confidence tradeoffs. Default componentwise policy is unchanged.
selection: All 100 previously inspected PubMed43 validation queries, same saved saliency initializations and three budgets. No CF2 support or edge is injected into proposal generation. This is development, not fresh confirmation.
gates: Check original-graph replay, support sizes, objective improvement and binary non-regression along each trace. Report all query-level wins, losses, tradeoffs, continuous metrics and actual proposal counts. Equal caps do not imply equal actual costs or that one final trajectory dominates another.
manuscript: Do not update empirical LaTeX data or present the optional policy as frozen before independent validation.
